title: Quick-fix Saudi Arabian Gorgonzola Dolce Flatbread
description: A tangy and flaky flatbread originating from Saudi Arabia, featuring Gorgonzola Dolce cheese and made with a double-rise bread recipe. This dish is perfect for a weeknight meal or a quick snack.

ingredients.name: Active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: instant yeast can also be used

instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a small bowl and let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
In a large bowl, mix together 2 cups of all-purpose flour, 1 tsp of salt, and 1 tsp of sugar.
Add the yeast mixture and 1 tbsp of olive oil to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
